## About
BSE Automotive is a repair shop and parts counter on W. Elizabeth Avenue, at the corner of Lumber Street in Linden. We handle brakes, exhaust, radiators, cv joints, tune ups, shocks, struts, oil changes and the rest of the general repairs that keep a car on the road.
Paul Chiaramonte runs the shop, and customers keep coming back because he is straight with them and charges fair prices. We are rated 4.9 on Google from 56 reviews.
We also sell aftermarket parts like head lamps, mirrors, bumper covers and hitches, new and used auto glass, and Interstate and ACDelco batteries.

## Services
- Brake and exhaust repair: Brake jobs and exhaust system repair for your car.
- Radiators, heater cores and condensers: A complete line for all makes and models of cars and trucks.
- Windshield replacement and auto glass: We sell and install new windshields, and sell new and used auto glass.
- Maintenance and tune ups: Tune ups, shocks, struts, differentials, oil changes, starters, belts, hoses and timing belts.
- CV joints and axle replacement: Front wheel drive axle replacement.
- Batteries: We sell and install Interstate and ACDelco batteries.
- Aftermarket auto parts: Lamps, mirrors, replacement wheels, radiators and auto glass.

## FAQ
Q: When is the shop open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: 218 W. Elizabeth Avenue, at the corner of Lumber Street in Linden.

Q: Do you sell used auto glass?
A: Yes. We sell both new and used auto glass.
